say:2:1421152001:1.text: Great! Now I know what to write for the final verse.
say:2:1421152001:1.source_cn: 好好好，第四段，英雄的成长，我已经差不多有数了。

say:3:1421152002:1.text: The next step is to write everything down, revise it, then make a fair copy and compose the music. It's going to be an amazing poem!
say:3:1421152002:1.source_cn: 接下来只需要先落到纸上，修改润色，再誊抄，最后谱曲，应...

say:4:1421152003:1.text: The instrument should be something light and portable, and the tune should be simple and catchy.
say:4:1421152003:1.source_cn: 乐器要选比较便携又简单的，曲子不要太复杂，最好上口点。

say:5:1421152004:1.text: Using a repetitive melody can highlight the theme and leave a stronger impression... I'll give it a try!
say:5:1421152004:1.source_cn: 之前我好像学过，用重复的曲调就能强调主题，让听众的印象...

say:6:1421152005:0.text: But everyone, there's one more thing...
say:6:1421152005:0.male: But everyone, there's one more thing...
say:6:1421152005:0.female: But everyone, there's one more thing...

say:7:1421152006:1.text: What now? Drop the act and just say it already.
say:7:1421152006:1.source_cn: 别撒娇，又有什么事了，说吧。

say:8:1421152007:1.text: Here's the thing—I'm not sure if I've used the right words or music for the poem.
say:8:1421152007:1.source_cn: 其实呀，因为我不太确定自己的用词和曲子选得怎么样。

say:9:1421152008:0.text: So, I was thinking of doing a smaller performance before the official debut. Zanie…
say:9:1421152008:0.source_cn: 所以，在正式发表之前，我想先小范围地稍微表演一下……祖...

say:10:1421152009:1.text: Thanks for inviting me, but I don't think I can make it with my hectic schedule these days.
say:10:1421152009:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的邀请，不过我最近忙得焦头烂额，就不去了。

say:11:1421152010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please send my regards to Indris and Ravion when you see them.
say:11:1421152010:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please send my regards to Indris and Ravion when you see them.
say:11:1421152010:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please send my regards to Indris and Ravion when you see them.

choice_prompt:12:1421152010.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please send my regards to Indris and Ravion when you see them.
choice_prompt:12:1421152010.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please send my regards to Indris and Ravion when you see them.

say:13:1421152011:0.text: Keep doing your thing. I've got to get back to work at the camp.
say:13:1421152011:0.source_cn: 那你们继续聊，苦命的我得会营地继续干活！

say:14:1421152012:0.text: What a shame... If the trial run goes well, I'll invite you to the official performance. You've got to be there!
say:14:1421152012:0.source_cn: 祖娅女士，真遗憾……如果我的演出能够顺利。重演的时候我...

say:17:1421152014:1.text: You two are definitely coming, right? I've already listed you as the co-authors!
say:17:1421152014:1.source_cn: 祖娅女士没有空……但是，你们二位肯定要来的对不对？因为...

choice_prompt:18:1421152014.text: You two are definitely coming, right? I've already listed you as the co-authors!
choice_prompt:18:1421152014.source_cn: 祖娅女士没有空……但是，你们二位肯定要来的对不对？因为你们也是合作者！我已经给你们写下名字了！

say:20:1421152016:1.text: Alright, I'll come, and I'll even help set up the venue for you. How about that?
say:20:1421152016:1.source_cn: 好好，我来，我不但来，我还提前点来帮你布置场地，可以吧？

say:21:1421152017:1.text: You're the best! Besides Captain Indris and Imperator Ravion, we should probably invite those who've given us ideas for the poem...
say:21:1421152017:1.source_cn: 你最好了！除了咱们，再邀请因度厄和沙利叶大人。或许还有...

say:22:1421152018:1.text: I'll get the invitation letters ready right away! See you then!
say:22:1421152018:1.source_cn: 我这就回去写邀请函！我们到时候见！
